title: Unhappy Dude-Southbound Vegas Blvd.mp3 by lonemonk
author: lonemonk
sourceDescription: June 21, 2010: Las Vegas City Bus. About 103deg outside, I got on this already PACKED bus in the North Strip after having visited the "Gold and Silver Pawnshop" of History channel fame. We stop at the Stratosphere hotel, and a guy with a thick NY accent gets on and starts to lay into the driver because of the wait. I'm standing mid-way on the stairway leading to the upper deck. Unhappy dude then continues his tirade right behind me; very tense. I can only imagine if I were this unruly on a bus anywhere else in the world, there would be a cop waiting for me at the next stop.
